description: Presidential Secretariat - Order call out all the members of the Armed Forces for the maintenance of Public Order with effect from August 27, 2024
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the implementation of statutory powers under existing legislation (Chapter 40) rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
